items.rationale: Percentage change compares the change with the starting value. Dividing the 120 increase by this year's 600 would give 20% instead of 25%, so the choice does change the answer.

The guard must test the cell you divide by, B6. In the swapped version the division runs exactly when B6 is 0, which gives #DIV/0!. Testing C6 does not protect against a zero in B6, and dividing by C6 uses the wrong base.
